lines.zh: 我两条腿还短，跑起来却快。
lines.en: My legs are short, but I run fast.

lines.zh: 脚掌贴地，慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: I press my feet down and shuffle on.

lines.zh: 掉队的那只，我会回去找。
lines.en: I'll go back for whoever falls behind.

lines.zh: 膝盖短，追起来倒不慢。
lines.en: My legs are short, but I'm not slow chasing.

lines.zh: 这片黑暗真大啊。
lines.en: This darkness is awfully big.

lines.zh: 我这一群，最多能到十五只。
lines.en: Our pack can reach fifteen strong.

lines.zh: 这块石头，我绕了第三回。
lines.en: Third time I've gone around this rock.

lines.zh: 我一声低叫，同伴都来。
lines.en: One low call and my pack comes.

lines.zh: 我闻到雨的味道，也闻到血。
lines.en: I smell rain, and I smell blood.

lines.zh: 谁把我睡的那片草压塌了？
lines.en: Who flattened the patch I sleep in?

lines.zh: 十五只一起出现，绕着猎场跑。
lines.en: Fifteen of us, circling the hunting ground.

lines.zh: 草在脚边，路在远处。
lines.en: Grass at my feet, the road far off.

lines.zh: 树影一块块，踩上去凉。
lines.en: The tree shade comes in cool patches.

lines.zh: 我还没长大，可牙已经尖。
lines.en: I am not grown, but my teeth are sharp.

lines.zh: 蹄子跑酸了，可队伍还在前头。
lines.en: My hooves ache, but the pack is ahead.

lines.zh: 哪块泥软，我一闻就知道。
lines.en: I can smell which mud is soft.

lines.zh: 前面那只一停，我也跟着停。
lines.en: The one ahead stops, and so do I.

lines.zh: 趁天还亮，多走一段。
lines.en: While it's light, I'll cover more ground.

lines.zh: 我好像忘了要往哪走。
lines.en: I seem to have forgotten where I was going.

lines.zh: 风一吹，草味压过了血味。
lines.en: The wind comes up, and grass beats blood.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，等他们全部跟上。
lines.en: I crouch, waiting for them all to follow.

lines.zh: 我年纪小，跑得比成体快。
lines.en: I am young, and faster than the adults.

lines.zh: 嘴边还有草渣，应该吃过了。
lines.en: There's grass on my lip. I must have eaten.

lines.zh: 我们一群最多十五只。
lines.en: We run in packs of up to fifteen.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，等到影子拉长。
lines.en: A little longer, till the shadows stretch.

lines.zh: 今天什么也不做，就趴着。
lines.en: Today I'll do nothing but lie here.

lines.zh: 我个头小，牙却已经长齐。
lines.en: Small as I am, my teeth are all in.

lines.zh: 十五只里，我最小。
lines.en: Of fifteen, I'm the smallest.

lines.zh: 我跑得比成体快，别追。
lines.en: I run faster than the adults. Do not chase.

lines.zh: 趴一会儿，等胃不叫了。
lines.en: I'll lie a while till my stomach quiets.

lines.zh: 我还小，叫得也不远。
lines.en: I'm small, and my voice doesn't carry.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见自己咽口水。
lines.en: So quiet I can hear myself swallow.

lines.zh: 身后有响动，我慢慢回头。
lines.en: Something moved behind me. I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 别吵，我在数一路的脚印。
lines.en: Quiet. I'm counting the tracks.

lines.zh: 我们十五个一起，够你受的。
lines.en: Fifteen of us at once. That's plenty.

lines.zh: 坐下来，跟我们一起晒太阳。
lines.en: Sit down and sun with us a while.

lines.zh: 我还没长出力气的牙。
lines.en: I haven't grown my strong teeth yet.

lines.zh: 我仰着头，一动不动地看你。
lines.en: Head tilted up, I watch you, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 十五只一起跑，声音很沉。
lines.en: Fifteen of us running makes a low sound.

lines.zh: 抬起头才看得见你的脸。
lines.en: I have to tilt my head back to see your face.

lines.zh: 昨天你也从这条路过去。
lines.en: You went down this path yesterday too.

lines.zh: 手里没东西，就别站着。
lines.en: Empty hands? Then don't stand there.

lines.zh: 先别走，你叫什么？
lines.en: Hold on. What's your name?

lines.zh: 我这两张嘴，还都小。
lines.en: Both my mouths are still small.

lines.zh: 我跑得比大的还快。
lines.en: I run faster than the grown ones.

lines.zh: 我的叫声低得传不远。
lines.en: My cry is low and carries nowhere.

lines.zh: 我还小，可我已经不客气了。
lines.en: I'm young, but I'm not shy about it.

lines.zh: 你走路的样子，这片林子没见过。
lines.en: The woods don't know your walk.

lines.zh: 你背后藏着什么，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell what's hidden behind your back.

lines.zh: 让我靠着石头喘两口。
lines.en: Let me lean on the rock and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 胸口那张嘴替我喊疼。
lines.en: The mouth on my chest cries out for me.

lines.zh: 擦破一点皮，我还能跑。
lines.en: Just scraped skin. I can still run.

lines.zh: 叫出来的声音，比平时更低。
lines.en: The sound I make comes out lower than usual.

lines.zh: 我叫得低，传不远。
lines.en: My call is low and carries little.

lines.zh: 打我的人，我记住你的鞋。
lines.en: Whoever hit me, I remember your boots.

lines.zh: 我还没长大，就已经疼了。
lines.en: Not grown yet, and already hurting.

lines.zh: 骨头没断，可抖得厉害。
lines.en: Nothing's broken, but I'm shaking.

lines.zh: 后腰挨了一下，我跳起来。
lines.en: Something hit my flank and I jumped.

lines.zh: 石头底下，有我的旧窝。
lines.en: Under the stone there's my old burrow.

lines.zh: 别收起来，我就跟在你脚边。
lines.en: Don't put it away. I'll stay at your heels.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，忘了看路。
lines.en: I stare at your hand and forget the path.

lines.zh: 鼻子贴上去，我不咬。
lines.en: I'll just put my nose to it. I won't bite.

lines.zh: 举那么高，我够不着。
lines.en: Hold it that high and I can't reach.

lines.zh: 嘴角滴下来的，我舔回去。
lines.en: It drips from my lip. I lick it back.

lines.zh: 你手里那点绿，分我一片。
lines.en: Share one leaf of that green stuff you hold.

lines.zh: 我叫声低沉，还传不远。
lines.en: My call is low and doesn't carry far.

lines.zh: 这味道甜，比草根强。
lines.en: It smells sweet, better than roots.

lines.zh: 你手里那束，是给我留的吗？
lines.en: Is that bunch in your hand for me?

lines.zh: 我这张嘴还没长齐，但牙够了。
lines.en: My mouth isn't full yet, but the teeth are.

lines.zh: 再往前递一点，就一点。
lines.en: Hold it out a little closer.

lines.zh: 你摊开手，我就信你一次。
lines.en: Open your hand and I'll trust you once.

lines.zh: 那束草一动，我的脚就动了。
lines.en: The bunch sways, and my feet move.

lines.zh: 你上次也带了同样的东西。
lines.en: You brought the same thing last time.

lines.zh: 你慢慢挪，我的鼻子跟着你。
lines.en: Move slowly, and my nose follows you.

lines.zh: 这株草，我还能再吃一口吗？
lines.en: Can I have one more bite of that grass?

lines.zh: 我蹲着啃草，是你先动的手。
lines.en: I was crouched eating grass. You moved first.

lines.zh: 我这身滑皮，撞一下就破。
lines.en: My slick hide tears at one bump.

lines.zh: 今天吃饱了，放你一马。
lines.en: I'm full today. Off you go.

lines.zh: 你踩进我们这一群里了。
lines.en: You've stepped into the middle of our pack.

lines.zh: 我这小身板，被你一碰就歪。
lines.en: One touch from you and my small body tips over.

lines.zh: 脚下有我们十几个小的。
lines.en: There are a dozen of us small ones underfoot.

lines.zh: 眼冒星星，脚步乱了。
lines.en: Stars in my eyes, my steps are off.

lines.zh: 只是蹭一下，我没生气。
lines.en: Just a brush. I'm not angry.

lines.zh: 我的叫声传不远，但你会听见。
lines.en: My call doesn't carry far, but you'll hear it.

lines.zh: 我们十几个挤在一起。
lines.en: A dozen of us, packed together.

lines.zh: 哪只脚踢的，我咬哪只。
lines.en: Whatever foot kicked me, I bite it.

lines.zh: 你一挤，我们几只全歪了。
lines.en: One shove and several of us tipped over.

lines.zh: 你身上有晒过太阳的味道。
lines.en: You smell of sun-warmed air.

lines.zh: 我的叫声还很低，传不远。
lines.en: My call's still low and doesn't carry far.

lines.zh: 你睡，我睁着两只眼。
lines.en: Sleep. I'll keep both eyes open.

lines.zh: 我这么小，叫声却传不远。
lines.en: I am small, and my cry does not carry far.

lines.zh: 我的叫声，还传不太远。
lines.en: My call still doesn't carry far.

lines.zh: 草心那截，我一直含着。
lines.en: I keep the tender heart of the grass for you.

lines.zh: 两张脸贴着，都不出声。
lines.en: Two faces pressed close, both silent.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我们并排去草地。
lines.en: At dawn we'll head to the grass side by side.

lines.zh: 我们一群最多十五个。
lines.en: Our pack runs up to fifteen.

lines.zh: 下一窝，也会是十五只。
lines.en: Our next litter will be fifteen strong.

lines.zh: 这根比我叼的那根直。
lines.en: This one is straighter than the stick I had.

lines.zh: 我先叼回窝里藏好。
lines.en: I'll carry it back and hide it in my nest.

lines.zh: 这东西不能吃，但能玩。
lines.en: Can't eat it, but I can play with it.

lines.zh: 它反光，我眯起眼睛看。
lines.en: It glints, and I squint at it.

lines.zh: 看见就叼，不必问谁掉的。
lines.en: I see it, I take it. No need to ask whose.

lines.zh: 两张嘴，总有一张闲着。
lines.en: Two mouths, and one is always free.

lines.zh: 别笑，我叼得稳。
lines.en: Don't laugh. I've got a good grip.

lines.zh: 叼不住，它从我嘴边滑下去。
lines.en: I can't hold it; it slips from my mouth.

lines.zh: 窝角那堆，又多了一件。
lines.en: One more thing for the pile in my nest.

lines.zh: 叼在左边，右边嘴还空着。
lines.en: Held on the left; my right mouth is still free.

lines.zh: 我们一群十五个，够你受的。
lines.en: Fifteen of us — that is more than enough.

lines.zh: 草丛在动，谁在上面？
lines.en: The grass moved — who's up there?

lines.zh: 那边的草倒了，是活的。
lines.en: The grass over there bent. Something's alive.

lines.zh: 你在后退，我数着呢。
lines.en: You're backing up. I'm counting.

lines.zh: 我们一群，最多十五个。
lines.en: Our pack runs up to fifteen.

lines.zh: 三只、四只，都跟上来了。
lines.en: Three, four of us have caught up.

lines.zh: 胸口的嘴也张开了。
lines.en: The mouth on my chest opens too.

lines.zh: 你的腿在草里，藏不住。
lines.en: Your legs show through the grass.

lines.zh: 你踩断了我盯的那根草。
lines.en: You snapped the grass I was watching.

lines.zh: 我的叫声低，传得不远。
lines.en: My call is low and does not carry far.

lines.zh: 别跑，我腿短追得慢！
lines.en: Do not run; my legs are short and slow!

lines.zh: 我跑这么快，爪子会打滑。
lines.en: At this speed my paws slip.

lines.zh: 你的汗味，我隔一丛草就闻到。
lines.en: I smell your sweat across a whole bush.

lines.zh: 我的叫声很低，传不了多远。
lines.en: My cry is low and does not carry far.

lines.zh: 你绕开，我就抄近路。
lines.en: Go around, and I'll cut the corner.

lines.zh: 我腿短，可我不喘。
lines.en: Short legs, but I'm not even panting.

lines.zh: 停一停，我还没看清你。
lines.en: Hold still. I haven't got a good look at you.

lines.zh: 这林子我闭着眼也走。
lines.en: I could walk these woods blind.

lines.zh: 几十只小蹄子，一起敲地。
lines.en: Dozens of little hooves drum the ground.

lines.zh: 停一下，让我闻清楚。
lines.en: Stop a moment and let me smell you.

lines.zh: 低头，用头顶你一下。
lines.en: Head down, and I butt you once.

lines.zh: 蹄子抬起来，往你膝盖上顶。
lines.en: Hoof up, straight at your knee.

lines.zh: 我才这么小，力气却用完了。
lines.en: So small, and already worn out.

lines.zh: 这一下，替窝里最小的。
lines.en: That one's for the smallest in the den.

lines.zh: 小个子也有两张嘴。
lines.en: Even the small one has two mouths.

lines.zh: 我还小，跑得却最快。
lines.en: I am young, but I run the fastest.

lines.zh: 幼崽的牙齿，先咬最靠前的那条腿。
lines.en: A pup's teeth take the nearest leg first.

lines.zh: 顶一下，就一下。
lines.en: One headbutt, just one.

lines.zh: 我们十几只一起跑，别数。
lines.en: A dozen of us run together, do not count.

lines.zh: 只咬裤脚，不咬肉。
lines.en: Only your trouser leg, not your flesh.

lines.zh: 成群的幼崽，一起叫。
lines.en: A pack of young ones, all calling.

lines.zh: 第一次睁眼，全是绿的。
lines.en: First look at the world: all green.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我从草里站起来。
lines.en: Day breaks, and I rise out of the grass.

lines.zh: 这地方闻着不错，有活人味。
lines.en: This place smells good: living people.

lines.zh: 我们一同睁眼，一同抬头。
lines.en: We open our eyes and lift our heads together.

lines.zh: 我两张嘴，一起张开。
lines.en: Both my mouths open at once.

lines.zh: 我叫声低，传不出这片林子。
lines.en: My low call does not cross the woods.

lines.zh: 我落脚很轻，先试试地面。
lines.en: I step lightly, testing the ground.

lines.zh: 我才落地，腿还软着。
lines.en: I just landed and my legs are still weak.

lines.zh: 一睁眼，还是这副小身子。
lines.en: I open my eyes to this small body still.

lines.zh: 我叫Baby John，请多关照。
lines.en: I'm Baby John. Nice to meet you.

lines.zh: 我的叫声还很低。
lines.en: My cry is still low.

lines.zh: 皮上冒烟，我在地上打滚。
lines.en: My hide is smoking. I roll on the ground.

lines.zh: 摔一下没事，我还能追。
lines.en: One fall is nothing; I can still chase.

lines.zh: 我还小，可我已经会恨。
lines.en: I'm small, but I already hate.

lines.zh: 炸得我两张嘴都合不上。
lines.en: The blast leaves both my mouths hanging open.

lines.zh: 箭头还在我腿上抖。
lines.en: The arrow's still quivering in my leg.

lines.zh: 有东西在我皮下游。
lines.en: Something crawls beneath my skin.

lines.zh: 饿得连叫声都变低了。
lines.en: Too hungry to raise my low voice.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的叫声都哑了。
lines.en: Lightning struck, and my cry went hoarse.

lines.zh: 没有草，没有气味，没有我。
lines.en: No grass, no scent, no me.
